Given $\phi = x^3 + y^3 + z^3 - 3xyz$.

1. **Find $\text{grad } \phi$:**
   $$\bar{f} = \text{grad } \phi = \frac{\partial \phi}{\partial x}\hat{i} + \frac{\partial \phi}{\partial y}\hat{j} + \frac{\partial \phi}{\partial z}\hat{k}$|
   $$\bar{f} = (3x^2 - 3yz)\hat{i} + (3y^2 - 3xz)\hat{j} + (3z^2 - 3xy)\hat{k}$$

2. **Find $\text{div } \bar{f}$:**
   $$\text{div } \bar{f} = \nabla \cdot \bar{f} = \frac{\partial}{\partial x}(3x^2 - 3yz) + \frac{\partial}{\partial y}(3y^2 - 3xz) + \frac{\partial}{\partial z}(3z^2 - 3xy)$$
   $$\text{div } \bar{f} = 6x + 6y + 6z = 6(x + y + z)$$
proTip: Double-check partial differentiation steps carefully to avoid sign errors when dealing with mixed variables.
